comment: The statement that large language and multimodal models are changing how clinical knowledge is summarised, retrieved, and acted upon may imply established benefit without acknowledging variable reliability and adoption.

anchor.note: p.104 l.Lines 5-6 read as the printed page; section 5 does NOT agree

public.text: The statement that large language and multimodal models are changing how clinical knowledge is summarised, retrieved, and acted upon may imply established benefit without acknowledging variable reliability and adoption.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with measured wording such as: “Large language and multimodal models are increasingly being explored for summarising, retrieving, and supporting the interpretation of clinical knowledge, although their reliability and appropriate use remain under evaluation.”
